summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Divjot Singh Arora's portfolio website. All features working perfectly with premium futuristic design, smooth animations, and responsive layout.
passed_tests: Hero section with gradient headline and floating 3D element
Smooth scroll navigation (View Work → Projects, Connect → Contact)
All 9 sections render properly (Hero, About, Projects, Achievements, Skills, Speaking, Ideas, Currently Building, Contact)
Responsive design on mobile (390x844), tablet (768x1024), and desktop (1920x1080)
Glassmorphism effects with backdrop-blur and transparency
Gradient text styling with proper bg-clip-text implementation
Hover effects on all interactive elements (cards elevate with -translate-y-2)
Typography: Outfit font for headings, Manrope for body text
Dark background (#05050A) matching design requirements
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing
Social links functionality (GitHub, LinkedIn, Email) with proper href attributes
Project cards display with proper content, images, and tags (AI, SaaS, Web Dev)
Achievement cards show TEDx Speaker, Josh Talks, VBYLD Finalist, GDG Growth Lead
Skills section organized by categories (Frontend, Backend, AI & Tools, Other)
Ideas Exploring section with status badges (Exploring, Building, Thinking)
Currently Building section with terminal-style design and pulse indicator
Contact section with 4 social links and gradient headline
Scroll animations trigger properly when navigating through sections
Bento grid layout in About section with image and story cards
All hover effects work (project cards, skill pills, social links, buttons)
